Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning architectural plans for school construction.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to architectural plans for school construction; andadding a new section to chapter 28A.525 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.525RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Each contract entered into by a school district for theconstruction or renovation of a school where funding for the project isprovided through voterapproved capital levies, voterapproved bonds,or where the state has contributed matching funds, must contain aclause stating that the architectural plans for the design ormodification of a school or any modifications of those plans are publicproperty and may be reproduced, modified, or used by the state or anyschool district in the state. This applies to contracts entered intoafter the effective date of this section. (2) Each school district board of directors shall file thearchitectural plans under subsection (1) of this section with thesuperintendent of public instruction. The superintendent of public p. 1 HB 2132instruction shall maintain these plans and make them available toschool districts throughout the state.
